paper_title: Tur[k]ingBench A Challenge Benchmark for Web Agents
caption: Distribution of errors in a single run of GPT4 across all tasks
model_annotation: The figure is a pie chart that illustrates the distribution of errors with GPT-4. The pie chart is divided into sections, each representing a category of errors, and labeled with a distinct color. The categories and their corresponding percentages are as follows: Incorrect, which is represented by a blue slice and accounts for 43.6%; Correct, represented by a red slice and making up 31.6%; Partial, represented by a yellow slice and comprising 11.3%; Unknown, represented by a light blue slice and accounting for 8.3%; Syntax Error, represented by a green slice and making up 2.3%; and Bad Response, represented by a gray slice and accounting for 1.5%. Each section is labeled with its category name and percentage, and a line connects the label to its corresponding section of the pie chart.
